episodes.name: An Elegant, Exclusive Atmosphere
episodes.plot: Indian immigrant Somen "Steve" Banerjee spends his days working at a gas station and his nights dreaming of being the next Hugh Hefner. A chance encounter with a Playboy centerfold and her slick promoter husband sends him in an unexpected new direction.

episodes.name: Four Geniuses
episodes.plot: As Chippendales takes flight, Steve assembles his dream team—including a shy accountant who may be more than just a business hire.

episodes.name: Velveeta
episodes.plot: While Steve is away in India, Nick cooks up his next creative triumph. But when Steve returns home, he has other plans for the show.

translations.value: While Steve is away in India, Nick cooks up his next creative triumph. But when Steve returns home, he has other plans for the show.

episodes.name: Just Business
episodes.plot: As Steve's new calendar flies off the shelves, a fed-up Nick makes a pitch to New York investors. A snub from Steve provides Otis with a sobering wake-up call.

translations.value: As Steve's new calendar flies off the shelves, a fed-up Nick makes a pitch to New York investors. A snub from Steve provides Otis with a sobering wake-up call.

episodes.name: Leeches
episodes.plot: While Nick takes the Big Apple by storm, Steve is back in LA staring down a discrimination lawsuit. Jealousy flares when Nick becomes a media darling--and the face of the brand.

episodes.name: February 31st
episodes.plot: As Steve's financial woes mount, Nick offers a lifeline in the form of a proposal that would take Chippendales global. A printing error has disastrous consequences for Steve.

episodes.name: Paper Is Paper
episodes.plot: Nick’s success on the road infuriates Steve, who turns to Ray to spy on him. As Steve reaches his breaking point with Nick, Irene reaches hers with her husband.

episodes.name: Switzerland
episodes.plot: In a bucolic Swiss village, Steve’s sins finally catch up with him. As he stares down the consequences of his actions, he makes a final, fateful choice.

translations.title: Ecco a voi i Chippendales
translations.overview: L'oltraggiosa storia di Somen "Steve" Banerjee, un immigrato indiano che è diventato l'improbabile fondatore del più grande impero di spogliarellisti del mondo, e che non ha lasciato che nulla gli ostacolasse il processo.
The outrageous story of Somen “Steve” Banerjee, an Indian immigrant who became the unlikely founder of the world’s greatest male-stripping empire—and let nothing stand in his way in the process.
translations.tagline: Every dream has a dark side.
